title: Data Analyst
description: We need a Data Analyst to turn operational data into decisions. You will write SQL against our warehouse, build Tableau dashboards for business teams, automate reporting in Python, and own data quality checks. A relevant analytics certification is preferred.
requirements: 2+ years in an analytics role. Advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs). Python for data wrangling with pandas. Tableau or an equivalent BI tool. Strong Excel for ad-hoc business modelling. Clear written communication of findings to non-technical stakeholders.
requiredEducation: Bachelor degree in statistics, economics, or a quantitative field
